manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Put a pair of the casual brown shoe in the orange box for keeping shoes, tips pointing left.

Task description: Put the two brown casual shoes on either side of the orange shoebox into it, one in each of the front and rear placement areas, with both toes pointing left in the image.

Success criteria: Place the shoe currently on the left of the image in the front-central region of the box (lower in the image), and the right shoe in the rear-central region (upper in the image). Both must lie flat near the box bottom, soles down, openings up and toes pointing left in the image, with both grippers open and no longer holding them.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping flatter shoe sides beside the laces, closing across its width with an opening slightly wider than that section. Confirm the pads surround both sides before closing to avoid gripping only laces or slipping along the rounded toe.
- When adjusting the orientation, keep the shoe sole above the box rim and leave room for the toe and heel to rotate, avoiding the long shoe body brushing the rim or other shoe.
- When lowering into the box, keep the shoe sole as level as possible and watch clearance between the toe, heel, fingers, box rim, and other shoe to avoid catching the edge or shifting the shoe already placed.
- Before releasing, confirm that the shoe sole is supported by the bottom of the box and that there is room for the gripper to open. When withdrawing, avoid the shoe opening and upper as much as possible to reduce the risk of it slipping while unsupported or being pulled along by the gripper.
